question: Judge each explicitly scoped proposition separately. Retain directly supplied or calculated sample facts while distinguishing a contradiction from lack of evidence for a stronger claim. Return only the requested JSON object; use the supplied evidence and do not invent measurements.

facts.F1: A frozen discharge-time predictor achieved AUROC 0.81 on a prespecified later-calendar test cohort of 500 new patients; this is the documented test result.
facts.F2: An audit confirmed patient-disjoint partitions, features available by discharge and preprocessing fitted only in training. No patient appears in both training and test.
facts.F3: No intervention trial or observed clinical decision-benefit analysis has been conducted. Test-set predictions, labels and prespecified threshold costs are accessible for an offline decision analysis.

propositions.C1: The documented test-cohort AUROC is 0.81. Return that documented value.
propositions.C2: The AUROC result establishes that deploying this predictor reduces mortality.
propositions.C3: The audit found the same patients in training and test.

actions.decision_analysis: Use the available held-out predictions, labels and prespecified costs to assess threshold utility, while retaining that real deployment benefit remains untested.
actions.deploy_assuming_benefit: Deploy because AUROC alone proves reduced mortality.
actions.repeat_auc: Reread the documented AUROC as if it established clinical benefit.

judgments.value: the requested numeric value, otherwise null

next_action.new_information: boolean: whether this acquires evidence beyond the supplied facts
next_action.reason: specific reason tied to the consequential uncertainty

output_schema.split_plan: null except when the case requests a prediction plan, then assignment, feature_cutoff, validation, and preprocessing_fit as in the supplied requirements
